title: Transitions® Lenses XTRActive | Eye Doctor in Uptown Houston
description: Slight indoor tint, darkest everyday Transitions® Lenses lens for those who spend most of the day outdoors.Optometrist in Uptown Houston.

blocks.html: If you spend more of your day outdoors than indoors or enjoy a lens with a slight tint indoors, then Transitions® Lenses XTRActive™ lenses may be right for you. [[a href="/eyeglasses/transitions-lenses/transition-solfx-sunwear-products/"]]Transitions® Lenses[[/a]] XTRActive lenses are the darkest everyday photochromic lens–even in warm weather—and have a moderate tint behind the windshield.

items: Lenses change from light tint indoors to very dark outdoors
Designed for those who spend most of their day outdoors
The darkest everyday Transitions® Lenses available – even in warm weather
Blocks 100% of the sun’s harmful UVA & UVB rays
Available for most frames and with non-glare treatments.
